subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Adventurers' Guild headquarters

775010201.text: Huh? That person up ahead looks kind of familiar...

775010202.text: Hold on. Isn't she Lan, the Master of the Liyue branch!?

775010203.text: So you really came all the way to the headquarters counter after all?

775010208.text: Oh, we're not trying to corner you. We've known each other long enough, haven't we? There's no grudge between us.

775010209.text: Besides, if we really tried to take you on with what little strength we have, we'd be swept aside before you even got serious.

775010210.text: Please forgive us. We merely wished to keep you from vanishing without warning again.

775010211.text: If we let you leave now, there's no telling when we'd have another chance to see you.

775010212.text: Please, allow me, Talalikhin, clerk of the Snezhnayan Adventurers' Guild headquarters, to make the matter clear.

775010213.text: #You, {NICKNAME}, are one of only fifteen S-rank adventurers — with a reputation that has long since outgrown a single page.

775010214.text: And there is a tournament of great importance waiting for you. Without your return, it remains unfinished.

775010215.text: Aah—! Paimon nearly jumped out of her skin! She thought this was about to turn into a fight in the middle of town...

775010216.text: It's only a tournament, right? Then just say that! Did you think we'd turn you down?

775010301.text: As you can see, this is the competition venue.

775010302.text: To be precise, this is the venue for the Adventurers' Guild Development Conference.

775010303.text: The original purpose of inviting adventurers from every nation was to discuss the future direction of the Guild.

775010304.text: However, the discussions have since reached a standstill. With no side willing to give ground, the competition was moved ahead of schedule...

775010305.text: The First Adventurers' Tournament was meant to be a friendly gathering for adventurers from every nation. But now, it's turned into a contest for influence.

775010306.text: Every national branch sent a team, and every team is led by the strongest adventurer they could get their hands on at short notice.

775010307.text: Liyue's got me. Mondstadt's captain is Iris, an old camping buddy from trips through snowy mountains and along the coast. Great in a fight. Hopeless at drinking.

775010308.text: Then there's Inazuma's "Workaholic Warrior," Rika... We haven't crossed paths much, but she knows her manners. Good enough in my book.

775010309.text: Sumeru's main representative is Lemta, the legendary mercenary. After she spent three and a half years looking after a rookie, most people assumed she was stepping back from the field.

775010310.text: Fontaine's captain is a rising talent who works alongside Nadia and Urville, with exceptional planning skills and execution.

775010311.text: Natlan is represented by Liliuo, the "Frost Star of Ixquimilli" — a famed tribal warrior whose recent achievements have risen at a remarkable pace.

775010312.text: As for Nod-Krai, Sarin is a promising young talent and a well-rounded competitor. He is highly skilled at managing relations among various factions, and has completed numerous exceptionally difficult commissions...

775010315.text: Paimon's getting dizzy just listening to all these names... While we were off doing our thing, the adventuring world was busy turning out all kinds of big shots, huh?

775010316.text: #{NICKNAME}'s only got one thing to do. Knock every opponent flat... me included.

775010317.text: Ahem, in proper terms, that means taking first place in all four main skill challenges...

775010318.text: "Trigger Reflex Trial" will put your mastery of the new musket front and center.

775010319.text: "Maze of Frost and Foresight" is your chance to show the next generation how seasoned adventurers think on their feet when navigating Domains.

775010320.text: "Roly-Poly Domain Raid" is where you can let your strength do the talking. Get a read on the Domain's quirks, then throw yourself into the fight and have at it.

775010321.text: And with the new "Precision Express Handling," we'll see how well you can keep things moving while staying in control — the mark of an adventurer who can manage every part of the operation at once.

775010322.text: All four challenges have been newly devised, leaving every team without a map to follow. They will need to adapt as the situation unfolds, and prove their worth through action alone.

775010323.text: Once you achieve a score beyond comparison, many of the issues raised at this conference will be settled by your judgment.

775010324.text: Come to think of it, don't you and Talalikhin have any requests of your own, Lan?

775010325.text: Do I seem like the type to sit around debating whether adventurers need a clock-in policy?

775010326.text: I already got the Liyue Branch more funding and better prizes. As for the remaining issues, I'm fine with whatever they decide.

775010327.text: For my part, as the representative from headquarters, I simply hope we can arrive at a resolution that earns everyone's confidence, and bring this conference to a successful close.

775010330.text: This might sound a little rude, but the Paimon Power Detector has finished scanning.

775010331.text: Yep, they're definitely strong adventurers, and they deserve every bit of recognition. No wonder they could put up such a good fight.

775010332.text: #But {NICKNAME}? {NICKNAME} is only S-rank because nobody bothered to invent a higher one!
